# rubyXL

**Tag**: data

## 简介

rubyXL is a gem which allows the parsing, creation, and manipulation of Microsoft Excel (.xlsx/.xlsm) Documents

## 官网

- 主页: http://github.com/gilt/rubyXL
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/rubyXL/3.4.38
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/rubyXL
